newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 4c to 620c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 4c to 620c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator fell four cents to 620 cents a kg clean on Tuesday at sales in Sydney and Adelaide, Wool International said.
Merino fleece was mostly cheaper, with 19/20 microns slightly dearer, 21m slightly cheaper, 22/26m 0.5 percent cheaper, 23/24m up to 1.5 percent cheaper, and 25m 2.5 percent cheaper, it said.
Merino skirtings of 19/20/21/22m were one percent cheaper.
In crossbreds, 27/28/31m were 0.5 percent cheaper, 29m slightly dearer and 30m slightly cheaper.
WI said Japanese interests and China were principal buyers with good support from local mills and Taiwan.
Of the 30,422 bales offered, 10 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Wednesday in Sydney and Adelaide with about 23,000 bales to be offered.
